result:
T-DG7-BE-F is partly done: all nine configuration-bundle operations work, but 11 of the 12 kinds have adapters (automation rules have none) and test T-D7 was not written. Every required check ran and exited 0 on the final tree. No migrations were added; the existing 0134 tables were enough.

**What works** (endpoints under `/api/v1/admin/config-bundles/…`):
- **Export:** only the latest published configuration goes out, keyed by stable codes. A source id found in any content refuses the export (422 `unportable_reference`). The stored file is re-hashed when downloaded.
- **Upload:** the schema version is checked first, so a wrong or missing version is refused (422) and nothing is stored. Then come the 5 MiB limit (413), the per-item checksum and the per-kind content check.
- **Validate and commit:** each item is planned as create, new draft, identical, conflict or refused. The commit re-plans and refuses with `plan_changed` if anything moved since validation, and writes everything in one transaction.
- **Safety rules, all tested:**
  - the six Studio kinds land only as drafts and are never published by the commit;
  - an open draft is never overwritten;
  - job schedules always arrive disabled;
  - each item needs the user's own right for that kind;
  - AUD gets 403 on all nine operations.
- **Kinds with adapters:** methodology, scoring defaults, form schema, procedure, automation rule set, health check scheme, review policy, job schedule, notification policy, upload policy, branding.

**Tests:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm openapi:lint` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm test`, first run | exit 1: two failures, both caused by my changes, both fixed |
| `pnpm test`, final tree | exit 0 (unit-node 2944, unit-web 2113, formula 259 + 2 skipped) |
| Integration on disposable PostgreSQL: contract, the two new bundle suites, BE-C's export suite, the guard probe | exit 0, 147 tests |
| Repo-wide prettier check | exit 0 |
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG6` | exit 0 |

The integration run covers T-D1–T-D6, T-D8 and T-D9. T-D6, the demo-to-clean round trip, passes: drafts published through the normal Studio steps get the same hashes as the source, and a re-export from the target matches.

**Not done:**
- **Automation rules:** no adapter. Rules carry owner and transformation ids that have no stable key, and their condition values have restricted-value handling that needs a decision before they go into a file. Asking for this kind by name is refused with 422; an "all kinds" export leaves it out and records only the kinds it covered. The "automation" part of M0356 is therefore only partly met.
- **T-D7:** not written. Publishing an imported draft goes through the existing operations, but no test checks that the migration and re-approval records match a hand-made publish.
- **New Studio keys:** a key the target has never published can't become a draft, because the database requires a published base. Such an item is refused. Between installations at the same migration level this doesn't happen, since all published keys come from migrations.
- **Reference checks:** only role codes are checked at plan time. Other missing references are caught by the database at commit, which rolls back the whole commit instead of showing up in the plan.
- **Stored import bytes:** the stored file is the canonical JSON of the checked bundle, not the raw upload. The module allow-list has no `node:stream`, so the raw body couldn't be kept. An unchanged exported bundle keeps its hash (tested); a hand-formatted file does not.

**Changes outside the listed files, flagged for the orchestrator:**
- the `./transfer` export line in `packages/shared/package.json`, which the work split reserves for the orchestrator;
- `@mth/shared/transfer` added to the module allow-list in `architecture.testkit.ts`;
- the adapter port types placed in shared, because adapters importing `transfer` would create a `jobs → transfer → jobs` module cycle;
- the branding token source moved into a shared constant in `server.ts`;
- an Arabic and English `_noParams` text for `schema_version_unsupported` that I derived; it isn't in D.2.

The handback lists these as Q1–Q7, along with the expected merge conflicts in the contract test count, the i18n files and `server.ts`.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG7/` (handback `T-DG7-BE-F-backend-workflow-engineer.md`, logs in `T-DG7-BE-F-evidence/`).
